images.prompt:
Use case: illustration-story.
Asset: AG-01-01, a professional university textbook editorial illustration about beginning AI creation with one real reader's need.
Scene: a quiet university studio corridor. At left is a tall real cork noticeboard covered with overlapping project documents and small abstract thumbnails: useful information, but overwhelming for a newcomer. In the foreground, one young adult student gently hands another young adult student a single, clearly arranged one-page project guide. The guide has three large simple landmarks drawn as document, folder, and magnifier shapes, not readable text. The receiving student studies the short guide with curiosity. The noticeboard recedes into soft detail; the one-page guide and interaction are the focal point. Show human care and clarity, not a promotional triumph. No computers or code screens are needed. People are ordinary fictional adult university students, natural proportions, minimal softly drawn facial features, plausible hands, simple clothing.
Metaphor: a guide gives a newcomer a place to begin; the useful work is deliberately small. No magical AI and no claims that a whole project fits into one page.
Medium: fine graphite and dark-ink line work, subtle hand-drawn hatching, restrained gouache washes, tactile warm paper, sophisticated contemporary technology-publishing illustration. Distinct from a top-down desk or open accordion folio. Grounded architectural perspective with ample breathing space around the figures. Not photorealism, not glossy 3D, not anime.
Composition: landscape 3:2, 1536x1024 or better, focal subject large enough to read on mobile. Paper-white #F6F3EB, ink #1D2433, indigo #5146D9, coral #F27A59, muted teal #3F958D. Quiet warm daylight.
No actual words, letters, numbers, slogans, logos, captions or figure numbers in the artwork. The noticeboard contains only abstract text strokes and geometric thumbnails. Avoid robot mascots, brain circuits, neon networks, awards, arrows and dense pictograms. All key elements inside the frame, no heavy border.

images.prompt:
Use case: illustration-story.
Asset: AG-01-03, a technology textbook illustration distinguishing an AI message that says a task is done from checking the actual file.
Create a sophisticated hand-drawn editorial diptych without a hard dividing border, landscape 3:2 at high resolution, on warm ivory paper.
On the LEFT a slim real laptop in three-quarter view. Its display has just one translucent speech bubble with a small simple checkmark; otherwise blank, no actual software interface, no text. The checkmark is merely the message being shown. The bubble casts a light, incomplete shadow suggesting a statement, not a physical deliverable.
On the RIGHT, foreground, an open real document folder with one substantial finished-looking guide sheet, two small source slips tucked under it, and a hand lifting the sheet to inspect it against those slips. A coral pencil has circled a single line on the sheet. The guide has abstract short text strokes and a simple thumbnail, not illegible fake words. A thin paper tab connects it to the folder: the important fact is that a real file can be found, opened and checked. No gold checkmark, no trophy, no perfection claims. A little empty space between laptop and folder invites the reader to make the distinction.
No arrow or data flow: this is a conceptual contrast, not a precise technical diagram or actual run screenshot. Only one naturally drawn human hand. Keep all important objects visible; avoid distracting desk clutter.
Style: confident graphite and ink contours, light crosshatching, matte gouache color and restrained paper-cut depth; more graphic and spacious than a realistic desk photograph. Professional and quietly witty science-publishing art for adult learners. Warm #F6F3EB ground, deep ink #1D2433, indigo #5146D9, coral #F27A59 and small teal #3F958D accents. Large shapes readable on a phone.
No letters, numerals, product names, logos, captions or figure numbers. No robots, neon, magical sparks, brain circuits, planets, plants, cups or stock tech imagery.
images.revision: Edit this textbook illustration only in the small thumbnail areas on the printed sheets. Preserve composition, laptop, single hand, warm paper, graphite and gouache style and palette. Remove ALL mountain/landscape/picture thumbnails from the large foreground guide and the source slips. Replace them with tiny simple line drawings of an ordinary document page with a folded corner, a file folder, and a few abstract short horizontal text strokes. No landscape, numerical chart, mountain, sun, nature imagery or irrelevant picture. The paper represents a guide to a software project and its source documents, not a travel brochure. Preserve the coral circle around one text line. No readable words, letters, logos or numbers. Everything else unchanged.
